info.title: Koro Sensei Quest!
info.synopsis: Preparatevi per una strana ma divertente avventura con il vostro gruppo preferito di assassini. La classe è tornata, ma questa volta la loro arma sarà... la magia ?! In questa nuova serie spin-off, seguiremo le chibi avventure della classe 3-E alle prese con spade e stregonerie nella Kunugigaoka Magic School. La loro missione? Sconfiggere il malefico Re Demonio Koro Sensei e affrontare le prove e i pericoli della loro scuola di magia!

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Koro-sensei and the students of Class 3-E travel to the northern cave to confront Karma Akabane the Red Devil, who is known to be unlucky when he is cocky, especially when washtubs randomly land on his head.

episodes.synopsis: Class 3-E finds a treasure chest deep in a cave, but it turned out to be empty when it is opened. To make matters worse, everyone switches bodies with someone else.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Kaede Kayano witnesses Nagisa and her pudding being abducted by Akira Takaoka the Merciless, ringleader of the Taka Gang. The students of Class 3-E goes to Fukuma Tower, where Nagisa is being held captive. On the second floor, Yuzuki Fuwa takes down Smog the Noxious by breaking the fourth wall.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The female students go to Irina to brew a potion for sacks of chocolates. On Valentine's Day, some of the female students give some of the male students the sacks of chocolates, but it turns the male students into monsters for a day.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: When Koro-sensei was a human, he was thought of as a hero, but became bored of his work. He was assigned by Aguri Yukimura to be a Demon King and live in a castle, since his predecessor (actually Neuro from Neuro: Supernatural Detective) retired from his position.
